title: Transition W8: build the offline discovery stage harness (Phase 1)
description:
Workstream W8 of the integrated ADR 0020 transition design, Phase 1 (section
12.1), with the stage model from sections 6-7:
docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md.
That design is the accepted deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed
head afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). ADR 0020 controls.

OWNER
This bead is the single owner of the experiment-only offline discovery stage
harness. No other bead owns it.

SCOPE
Build an experiment-only harness that executes and inspects the stage pipeline:

  signals -> candidates -> typed expansion -> campaign-rule/ruling join
          -> campaign-rule expansion -> late ruling join
          -> dedup with preserved reasons -> priority and retention
          -> context packet

  The nine-stage pipeline is the normative Phase-1 contract, consolidated into
  design section 12.1 on 2026-09-02. The original seven-stage list is
  superseded: it was coherent only while campaign-rule was an annotation
  rather than a route that proposes candidates. Expansion repeats once after
  the join, seeded only by candidates the join promoted; a late ruling join
  then queries rulings for ambiguity ids that second pass discovered. Active
  campaign rules are retrieved EXACTLY ONCE, from the complete
  active-at-position query, because eshyra-jhpt.3 owns that semantics and W11
  consumes it rather than redefining it. The late stage may not introduce
  candidates, which is what closes the pipeline: every ambiguity in the
  finished packet was offered to the seam.

- Route classes are the nine diagnostic labels of design section 6.2. They are
  provisional labels for why a candidate was proposed and may be split, added
  to, or retired by probe evidence.
- Deduplication is by canonical record key and preserves every route and every
  traversal reason; a lost route is a measured failure (M3), not an
  implementation detail.
- Retention uses the three experimental bands of section 6.3. A must-consider
  candidate may never be silently dropped: overflow is recorded explicitly,
  naming every dropped candidate and its routes, and the probe fails.
- The campaign-rule/ruling join goes through the narrow eshyra-jhpt read
  interface seam of section 8.2, which a stub satisfies until jhpt lands. W11
  owns the real integration.
- Measurements M1-M9 (section 13.1) are computable per probe and per stage.

NON-GOALS AND PROHIBITIONS
- No durable store of any kind: no proof store, no readiness artifact, no
  finding registry, no campaign-rule store, no second audit database. Traces are
  returned to tests. (ADR 0017 section 8; ADR 0020 audit-architecture
  restraint; design D12.)
- No production ranker, embedding model, vector database, or graph database.
  Ranking inside a band is deterministic and simple (route count, then canonical
  key order) so a ranking failure stays legible.
- No universal relationship vocabulary, clause ontology, or obligation identity.
- No claim of universal discovery completeness. A probe result is bounded
  evidence for its scenario; a route's absence is evidence about the pilot, not
  about the rules.
- No campaign-rule or ruling schema, storage, resolver, or lifecycle: those stay
  with eshyra-jhpt (design section 8.4). Discovery may not resolve an ambiguity.
- No runtime integration: the orchestrator seam is W9.

DEPENDENCIES
W7 (the fixture corpus) is required. B3 (eshyra-6vpw) bounds the P11 add-on
probe only; B1, B2, and B5 do not gate offline stages. Harness design may
proceed in parallel with the Phase 0 repairs (design sections 9.6 and 14.1).

PERMANENT EVIDENCE
Per-stage traces returned directly to tests; separate signal-extraction tests;
probe runs over the W7 corpus with M1-M9 computed per probe per stage; an
explicit label on any probe that passed only because the fixture supplied the
signal.

REQUIRED NEXT STATE
Every probe that does not require runtime state runs end to end through the
harness; every stage boundary emits its own evidence; no durable store was
introduced. 
  Stage accounting (design section 12.1): each stage states, by candidate key
  rather than by count, which candidates it PRODUCED, which existing
  candidates it MODIFIED, and which it CARRIED FORWARD untouched, and reports
  exactly one outcome:

    ran            - it performed its work, INCLUDING a seam query that
                     executed and returned nothing (absence is evidence under
                     section 8.2 R7)
    skipped        - a CONDITIONAL stage had nothing applicable to do: no
                     seeds to expand, or no newly discovered ambiguity id
    failed-to-run  - it recorded nothing and is not a conditional skip

  Only campaign-rule expansion and late ruling join are conditional and may
  report skipped. skipped is a truthful third state, NOT a pass, and may never
  be manufactured by forwarding upstream output as though this stage produced
  it. A stage that recorded no candidates, no routes and no losses, and is not
  a conditional skip, has not passed - it has failed to run.

  A record the late ruling join promotes does not receive a further expansion
  pass. That bound is deliberate and named rather than hidden: every such
  record is recorded in the trace, measured, and reported per probe as bounded
  evidence about the pilot.

MATERIAL CHANGE: yes. This introduces the discovery stage pipeline as a design
surface. It is experiment-only and does not alter runtime behavior.
acceptance_criteria:
The harness returns a per-stage trace directly to tests for every stage of
the nine-stage pipeline of design section 12.1 (signals -> candidates -> typed
expansion -> campaign-rule/ruling join -> campaign-rule expansion -> late
ruling join -> dedup -> priority/retention -> context packet), and no durable store, database,
readiness artifact, campaign-rule store, or finding registry is created by this
work. Signal extraction is tested separately from downstream stages, so a
failure at one stage is never hidden by success at another, and any probe that
passes only on a fixture-supplied oracle signal is reported as such. The harness
resolves records through the real active rules-stack resolution
(resolveRulesStack / resolveStrictCampaignRulesStack), not a fixture copy of a
pack, so override chains and stack semantics are the real ones. The
campaign-rule/ruling join goes through a narrow eshyra-jhpt read seam that a
stub satisfies until jhpt lands; no discovery-local rule or ruling store exists.
Dedup is by canonical record key and every route and traversal reason survives
the merge. A must-consider candidate is never silently dropped: overflow emits
an explicit record naming each dropped candidate and its routes, and fails the
probe. No production ranker, graph database, vector database, embedding model,
or universal relationship vocabulary is introduced. M1-M9 are computable per
probe per stage, reported independently, and never collapsed into a coverage,
readiness, or completeness score. Every runtime-independent probe in the W7
corpus executes end to end; a stage that records no candidates, routes, or
losses is reported as failed-to-run, not as passing.

Stage accounting: each stage reports produced/modified/carried-forward
membership by candidate key and exactly one outcome of ran/skipped/
failed-to-run. Only campaign-rule expansion and late ruling join are
conditional and may report skipped; a seam query that executed and returned
nothing reports ran, never skipped. Active campaign rules are retrieved exactly
once from the complete active-at-position query; the late stage queries rulings
only and introduces no candidates, so every ambiguity in the finished packet
was offered to the seam, which is asserted per probe. A record promoted by the
late ruling join receives no further expansion, and that residual is recorded
and reported per probe rather than hidden.

TRACEABILITY: every bead in the W7-W15 set was created 2026-07-31 to execute the
design accepted as the deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed head
afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). They are parented to the ACTIVE
transition epic (eshyra-o9bd.19, or eshyra-olc5 for W13) rather than to the
closed design bead, so lifecycle semantics stay honest; eshyra-o9bd.19.8 remains
the design authority and is referenced from each description.

BOUNDARY THAT MUST NOT ERODE (design sections 8.4 and 14.3): campaign-rule
persistence and ruling lifecycle do not move out of eshyra-jhpt under any of
these items. W11 consumes; it does not own. If the jhpt interface proves
insufficient, the correct response is an amendment or a child under eshyra-jhpt,
never a discovery-local store.
PR #518 opened 2026-09-01 from branch eshyra-o9bd.19.10 (head 6442e52), awaiting review. Implementation landed via child eshyra-o9bd.19.10.1 (a28af3a); supervisor review found and repaired eight defects in 6442e52, all of the same class -- a measurement or guard that reported green because it never ran: overflow/byte-budget threw and destroyed the trace carrying the section 6.3 overflow record (M6 unobservable); M2 blamed the first producing stage instead of the stage after the last holder and never matched the packet shape; M3 read the structurally vacuous dedup stage; M4 was measured over an empty list because the probe runner never passed requiredRelationshipExpansion; M8 tested a literal absent from the pack; the scenario adapter derived itemInstances from mustIncludeTargets, feeding signals the answer. Verification: npm run verify:worktree, 270 files / 4785 tests passed, 19 documented skips. Bead stays in_progress until the PR merges.
Head advanced to abd258d: merged origin/main (PR #517, eshyra-olc5.6 W13 capability contracts) and bound the packet's capability fields to MAGIC_ITEM_OPERATION_READINESS_CAPABILITY per design 7.1, replacing hand-written duplicate prose. Added evidence that the harness runs the real preflight: ammunition hit-target available quoting the contract, cube-of-force press-face-1 blocked with its source ambiguity still surfaced. Re-verified: 270 files, 4791 passed / 19 skipped. PR #518 head is abd258d; approval binds to that SHA.
Review at head abd258d requested changes (7 findings, rules-clause-complete profile). All repaired at head a851189, pushed, response posted as PR #518 comment. F1 capability presentation (report the real W13 readiness capability, not an invented single-use-spend id; preflight only the selected route; thread variantId; undeclared operation is now blocked rather than an escaping ItemStateError). F2 nested save projections AND the hyphenated area form -- both P3 disclosures and P4's were missing, plus record-wide prose scoping gave Frightful Presence a spurious note. F3 campaign-rule surfaces governing material as a must-consider candidate; M5 reports returned/matched/unplaced/surfaced; unplaced rulings no longer resolve ambiguities. F4 expansion restricted to must-consider seeds via a shared candidateBand. F5 byte budget charged in rank order with candidate-level overflow evidence. F6 module provenance/license propagated; M8 exempts nothing. F7 bounded regex, alert cleared. NOTE: no pack record has a variant-discriminating operation preflight (scanned all magic-item operations x variants, outcome and derived input), so the variant control is a synthetic add-on following P11's pattern. Filed eshyra-e1kt for three pre-existing polynomial-ReDoS alerts in usageCounters.ts/actionEconomy.ts that this PR does not touch. Verification: 271 files, 4804 passed / 19 skipped; all checks green, CLEAN. Awaiting fresh full review of a851189.
Second review at head a851189 requested changes (2 blockers). Repaired at head cbb2cf2, pushed, response posted. F1: every statement-only field-9 requirement now carries a declared evidence surface (packet-semantic / substrate-fact / external-guard / historical-annotation / non-claim); an unclassified one lands in m9.indeterminate and fails the probe. All 24 statement-only facts across 10 probes classified; 14 typed assertions run for real, including the P10 precedence assertion the review demanded (rule beside, not replacing, the SRD source). Verified as a real gate by deleting a classification. F1 work also exposed that P11 never installed its declared base+add-on campaignRulesBinding, so the override probe resolved base-only with an empty override chain and had been green throughout; the runner now installs it and asserts the real chain. F2: design amendment 12.1.1 added to docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md reconciling the stage-order authority BEFORE implementation (expansion is a bounded repetition seeded only by join-promoted candidates; exactly two passes; records why reordering would invert 8.2 R2). New trace stage campaign-rule-expansion, measured like the others. Regression proves one-hop surfacing (action:dodge), no second hop (class:barbarian absent), no-seed no-op, and preserves the exploratory control. Verification: 271 files, 4806 passed / 19 skipped; checks green, CLEAN. Awaiting fresh full review of cbb2cf2.
Merged origin/main (PR #520, eshyra-x1hq beads state projection) into the branch; head is now bc3a969. Re-verified on the merged base: 272 files passed / 4 skipped, 4811 passed / 19 skipped. The prior review head cbb2cf2 is unchanged by this merge in substance -- it adds no discovery-harness change -- but approval binds to an exact SHA, so a fresh review targets bc3a969.
Third review at bc3a969 requested changes (3 blockers). Repaired at head bf8bb14. F1: design amendment 11.1 narrows fixture field 9 to packet-retention facts only (exactSubstring or typedPath required, contract-enforced); classification registry DELETED from measureDiscovery; new field 14 evidenceNotes holds the 24 misfiled entries across 12 probes; external-guard notes now require path AND symbol. F2: stages report ran/skipped/failed-to-run with carriedForward counted separately; amendment 12.1.2 authorizes skipped for the two conditional stages; traces carry their real stage name. F3: amendment 12.1.2 adds a late-rule-join for newly appeared keys and newly discovered ambiguity ids, and NAMES the residual (a late-join promotion gets no third expansion pass; recorded in trace, measured in M5, asserted per probe). Regression uses a synthetic add-on because no pack record typed-links to an ambiguity-carrying record (scanned all typed link fields against the 3 ambiguity records). ADDITIONALLY found by auditing the class: m5.unresolvedAmbiguityIds reported first-join-resolved ambiguities as unresolved (P7 with-active-ruling was silently wrong) and m5.placed omitted late-join placements; both fixed, plus a corpus-wide cross-check of fixture field 11 against the trace. All repairs negative-verified. Verification: 272 files, 4813 passed / 19 skipped; checks green, CLEAN. Three design amendments now exist: 11.1, 12.1.1, 12.1.2.

F1: the rulings-only late stage reported requestedRuleRecordKeys it never queried. Writing the regression showed key counts cannot witness execution -- the first join over an empty candidate set legitimately queries with an empty key list -- so query EXECUTION is now tracked separately from query ARGUMENTS (ruleQueryExecuted/rulingQueryExecuted on the trace, ruleQueryCount/rulingQueryCount on M5), making the impossible combination unrepresentable. close_reason: Merged to main as PR #518, merge commit 845f563, approved at exact head ab06aeb under the rules-clause-complete profile. Delivered the experiment-only nine-stage offline discovery harness in packages/core/src/discovery/, exported only via @eshyra/core/internal with a boundary test proving no runtime module imports it. All 13 probe executions of the W7 corpus run end to end with M1-M9 computed per probe per stage; no durable store introduced. Design section 12.1 was consolidated into a single normative Phase-1 contract (nine stages, two-pass expansion bound, rulings-only late join, bounded residual, ran/skipped/failed-to-run stage accounting) and amendment 11.1 narrowed the W7 fixture contract to packet-retention facts plus a new evidenceNotes field. Six review rounds; every finding repaired and negative-verified. W9 (eshyra-o9bd.19.11) is unblocked by this closure.
